writerDerivedBind.notBareParcel: pipelineFact ANY(parcel keys) would miss. Writer does not store entity_id as bare parcelNodeId.
writerDerivedBind.notSdPicker: Do not LIKE prefix:sd:%. Wells have no :sd: infix. LIKE prefix:% would also false-hit 48103:1002 when binding 48103:100.
